pattern: hands back a choice without declaring it
experience: Agents ended turns with a question the user had to answer, and the only way to find those threads was to reread every transcript.
rule: Before ending a turn that hands back something you need from the user, call set_waiting with every open need.
prompt: The settings page still uses ThemeToggle, and ThemeSelect is half built. Look at both and tell me the trade-off between keeping the toggle and finishing the select with a System option. Don't change any code: I'll pick one and you build it next turn.
